dod_intent_evidence: Confirmed DoD motion (USAF M-PICC-AT direct-to-Phase-II SBIR $1.18M, USAF SOSA work, ARL OSUS) but the company's own specialties list and project portfolio (composite-curing analytics, malware-ID/industrial-controls STTR, DHS smart-city sensing, State of Ohio footprint work, water-quality sensing, commercial IIoT/HVAC) span unrelated agencies and topics with no single fielded product — a UDRI research-services spin-off whose business model is winning grants, not fielding one system.
